results.fact: Which line this route is (ridge vs Meade Glacier)
results.evidence: The row blends two distinct lines. The Klickton Divide line (southwest to the divide, northwest along it to the summit block) involves no glacier travel (Mazamas trip listings; onehikeaweek trip report). The Meade Glacier line proper leaves the Surprise Lake loop high point (~5,600 ft), crosses a basin west, climbs the Meade to the SSE ridge and does not use Klickton Divide (ericsbasecamp; Mountaineers description of the Meade variant). Making name, overview, beta, baseFinding and pitch_detail agree means deciding which line this row represents and rewriting its core prose - not a minimal patch, so left for an owner decision.

The Jul-Sep chip is the main window (climate.summer says the same); best_season explicitly describes late June and October as shoulder conditions around it. A July ascent and a late-September ascent are both documented.
